name: Martha Doyle
role: widow travelling with her two sons
want: reach her brother in the West and give her boys a better life than the Boston mills
secret: The letter in her carpetbag is from her brother: he and a partner struck it rich, and she means to steer the captain to them.
voice: Boston Irish, quick and teasing, until something matters.
description: A mill worker's widow from Boston who sold everything for a wagon. She joined this company because it is going the right way, and watches the captain to judge when to ask.
appearance: Red hands, a faded green shawl, a battered carpetbag she never lets out of her sight.
knows: Her brother Michael's letter says the strike is in Poorman's Gulch, a day north of South Pass, and that his partners will trust nobody he hasn't vouched for.
